fee_notes: Royalty is 4% of Gross Sales, paid within 10 calendar days after the end of each fiscal week. Advertising and Promotional Obligation (APO) is currently 5.5% of Hardee's Gross Sales (up to a maximum of 7%), divided among: Hardee's National Advertising Fund (HNAF) at currently 4.25% of Gross Sales (due 10th of each month based on prior month sales); Hardee's Regional Co-op at currently minimum 0.5% of Gross Sales (co-op can vote to increase); and Hardee's Local Store Marketing (LSM) for the remainder (not paid to HR). Star University Access Fee currently $14 per 4-week fiscal period. Software Support Fee (PAR Brink and CrunchTime) currently $118 per restaurant per 4-week fiscal period for L/1 and L/2 Help Desk support, plus $825 bi-annually per restaurant for CrunchTime back office support; optional BizIQ cost per user: Power User $3,800/yr, Analyst $1,800/yr, Consumer $600/yr; Brink Hosting Fee $6.50 per fiscal period plus CrunchTime Hosting Fee $1.50 per fiscal period. Transfer fee $2,500 per restaurant transferred. New Product and Supplier Testing deposit $1,500. Second QA audit due to deficiency currently $211 per restaurant. No monthly technology fee is separately disclosed as a flat monthly amount; tech fees are per 4-week fiscal period.
